summary: Iteration 7 retest of Global Presence world map after applying iteration-6 RCA fix. ALL acceptance criteria PASS. CSS change verified: .rl-worldmap-inner now has computed aspect-ratio '1920 / 975' and renders as 1040x528 (image fills 100% with no letterboxing). Footprint.jsx pins array matches exactly: gb(47,24), ae(62,38), in(70,43), my(77.5,51), sg(78,53). Measured image-relative positions equal the inline style values (container=image now). Visual inspection at 1920x1000 and 1440x900 confirms: UK pin on British Isles, UAE on Arabian peninsula, India on Indian subcontinent (user's #1 criterion met), Malaysia on Malay peninsula, Singapore at tip of Malay peninsula. Behavior: clicking worldmap-pin-in opens india-cities-expand; clicking worldmap-pin-ae does NOT toggle it (expand stays in its prior state); second click on worldmap-pin-in collapses the panel. No regressions observed.

issues: Malaysia and Singapore pins (77.5/51 and 78/53) are very close; Malaysia label may visually overlap/hide behind Singapore label at smaller viewports. Consider offsetting Singapore label below the dot (top:+14px) for visual separation. Cosmetic only, not blocking.
